versions.content: Semantics of CryptoServiceMapping Meta-class Cryp- toServiceMapping represents an abstract base class for the creation of mappings in the context of cryptographic operations. Concrete sub-classes define the mapping with respect to specific cryptographic use cases, e.g. SecOC, TLS.
